title: docs(search): four data-read pages describe `search` without the empty-search-set refusal PR #24320 added (error-handling, data-api, queries, query-syntax)
body:
**Filing gate ①**: shipped documentation made incomplete by a landed change, the follow-up a landing owes (「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」). One close-out card for the whole family: every hand-written page that describes the data read route's `search` and does not name the refusal. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023, owner of `content/docs/**`), in one docs-only PR. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 · `os-warren` · `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, from the Acceptance notes of PR #24353 (#24331, the error catalog's own entry). Lane self-labelled under rule B (#23733); grade is triage's.

## What landed

PR #24320 landed as `ec749fbb44` (#24284). From it on, a non-blank `search` on an object whose resolved search set is empty is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` with `param: 'search'`, on every verb that expands a search (`find`, `findOne`, `count`, `aggregate`) and every door that reaches the engine. Before it, that search answered every row. The code is `emptySearchSetError` and its call site in `ObjectQL.expandSearchOnAst` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`); the set is resolved by `resolveSearchFieldResolution` (`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts`). PR #24353 adds the refusal to `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`'s `INVALID_FIELD` entry only.

## The family, enumerated (each on `origin/main` at `e4bcced0b4`)

1. `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`, about L625–L627: says the catalog's `INVALID_FIELD` entry "enumerates every read axis this one code answers on", and its parenthesis lists `select`, `expand`, `searchFields`, `groupBy`, `aggregations[].field` — no `search`.
   - Re-check: `grep -cF` of that parenthesis (backticks included) → 1; control `grep -c 'enumerates every read axis'` → 1.
2. `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`: the `search` query-parameter row (about L26) and the request → result table (about L153–L158), which has `searchFields` refusal rows and no row for a bare `?search=` on an object with no searchable field.
   - Re-check: `grep -ciE 'no searchable field|search set is empty|resolved search set'` → 0; control `grep -c searchFields` → 6.
3. `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx`, the "Full-Text Search" section (about L476): field resolution and narrowing only.
   - Re-check: same pattern → 0; control `grep -c searchFields` → 6.
4. `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`, about L1120–L1127: field resolution, the `searchFields` refusal, and "Internal callers reaching `engine.find()` directly keep the tolerant intersection". The empty-set refusal is thrown in the engine itself, so an internal caller meets it too.
   - Re-check: same pattern → 0; control `grep -c searchFields` → 5.

Enumeration pin: `git grep -lE 'searchableFields|searchFields' origin/main -- content/docs` minus `content/docs/references/` (generated) and `content/docs/releases/` (release-owned). Each hit is read once and either carries the refusal after the PR or is named in the PR body as not describing the data read route's `search`.

## Target

- Each page states the refusal where it describes `search`, in that page's own register, read from the code above (the code wins over this card's wording).
- `error-handling.mdx`'s parenthesis names `search`; `data-api.mdx` gains one table row.
- ⛔ `content/docs/references/**` and `content/docs/releases/**` are out of scope. `skip-changeset` applies (docs only).

## Dedupe

REST enumeration of the 1000 most recently updated objectstack items (547 issues, back to 2026-10-14T11:17Z, read 2026-10-18T14:44Z), intersecting the four page names with `searchable|search set|searchableFields`: 0 hits. Controls: the page names alone hit 9 items; the search words alone hit 12, #24331 and #24284 among them. PR #24353 (opened after the scan) is the source.

Dedupe words: search empty resolved search set docs; INVALID_FIELD param search data-api; error-handling read axis search; query-syntax internal callers tolerant intersection search.
